newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex to improve unleaded gasoline in Mexico City.
newsitem.headline: Pemex to improve unleaded gasoline in Mexico City.

text.p: Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) is planning to introduce a better quality unleaded gasoline in the Mexico City metropolitan area in the last quarter of 1996, the head of the state oil monopoly said.

"We are preparing to introduce in the fourth quarter of this year ... a reformulated gasoline in the Valley of Mexico that will help reduce emissions in the atmosphere," Adrian Lajous told reporters after a ceremony to mark the anniversary of the Mexican Petroleum Institute on Friday.
He said the unleaded gasoline would continue to be called Magna Sin. -- Henry Tricks, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9560
